# Kaftan Angelo — Leather, Shearling and Fur in Budapest

Kaftan Angelo offers leather jackets for women and men, shearling coats, fur styles and leather accessories. The Budapest store opened in 2004. Angelo's leather-working story began in Istanbul in 1973.

## Store
- Address: Kossuth Lajos u. 18, Budapest 1053, Hungary.
- Telephone: +36 1 266 7274.
- WhatsApp: +36 20 359 3216.
- Monday–Friday: 10:00–19:00. Saturday: 10:00–17:00. Sunday: closed.
- [Visit and map](https://kaftanangelo.com/en/visit/).

- [Leather, shearling, fur and accessories](https://kaftanangelo.com/en/collections/).
